capabilities: Sync #todo task lines with Todoist, including subtasks, priorities, sections, and dates
Answer questions from the vault using semantic search with links back to source notes
Turn notes, selections, or forwarded emails into main tasks and subtasks
Schedule open tasks across a workday with a preview and undo
Draft or rewrite text directly into the open note, citing vault sources
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not only a task sync; it also includes an AI chat sidebar, email-to-task processing, day planning, and in-note writing.
extras: Free, open source under GPLv3, no telemetry; requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later and works on desktop, iPhone, and iPad; email processing needs a self-hosted Cloudflare Worker URL and token.
problem: Obsidian notes and Todoist tasks live in separate tools, so turning written work into synced, deduplicated Todoist tasks takes manual copying.

relations.evidence: You need a Todoist account and token for Todoist jobs
OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, OpenRouter, a self-hosted Open WebUI with Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint

summary: Todoist sync and AI assistant that turns note lines into tasks, answers questions from your vault, and plans tasks across a workday.
